newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom seeks bigger stake in AOL venture-magazine.
newsitem.headline: Telekom seeks bigger stake in AOL venture-magazine.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG wants to acquire a bigger stake than previously planned in the Euuropean joint venture of U.S. online service America Online (AOL), news magazine Der Spiegel reported.

State-owned Telekom, due to be floated on the stock market this month, will hold talks on the plan with partners America Online and Bertelsmann AG this week, Spiegel said in a report released ahead of publication in Monday's edition.
Telekom chief executive Ron Sommer regards the initially planned 10 percent stake in the joint venture as too small, the magazine said. Telekom could not immediately be reached for comment.
America Online, its European partner Bertelsmann, Deutsche Telekom and publishing group Axel Springer Verlag AG last November struck a deal to cooperate in providing online services in Europe.
The agreement included Deutsche Telekom taking a stake in the European joint venture between Bertelsmann and America Online.
